Heating should work once repressurised. Since the portal doesn't offer a channel option matching his preference, I'll reply via email instead, using the address on file since that's his preferred contact method. I can mention the scheduled visit on 2026-10-14 as noted in the system.

arguments.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your messages on the portal. Boiler job: the engineer visited on 30 Sept and found the part causing the pressure drops (an expansion vessel) needs replacing. The quote was £780, and your landlord has asked for a second quote before deciding. Swift P&H are down to visit on 14 October for that. No repair can start until the landlord has decided, so I can't give you a fix date yet. I'm sorry it's taking a while. In the meantime, if the boiler loses heating or hot water completely, or you notice a gas smell, tell us straight away. For a gas smell, leave the property and call 0800 111 999. We'll update you by email by Thursday 15 October. Bins: we don't manage collections, so I can't see the schedule. Tower Hamlets Council runs them. Their website has a collection day checker and a missed-collection report form. Please report it there.
